{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print("Completed orders count:", len(completed))

# Check revenue: strip commas and convert to float
completed['revenue_numeric'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify that the revenue parsing worked
print("Sample of parsed revenue:", completed['revenue_numeric'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for any remaining QA orders
qa_check = completed[completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders in completed set:", len(qa_check))"}
